module: GE extension `core_playerPersonas`: visual identity of local players in multiplayer (multiseat). A 'persona' groups a displayed name, an icon, a color and optionally a favorite vehicle, numbered from 1 (player 0 = persona 1). Default values are generated: translated name 'ui.multiseat.playerTag', icon drawn from a pool (random offset per session), color from a palette of 8 hues (computed in OKLCH). A modder uses it to get the name, color and icon of a local player.
usage:
local n = core_playerPersonas.getNumberForPlayer(0) -- 1
local p = core_playerPersonas.get(n)
log('I','', p.displayName .. ' ' .. p.colorHex .. ' ' .. p.icon)
notes: get(number) returns a table built on the fly: { id ('local-persona:N' by default), number, displayName, icon, color = {r,g,b} (0..1), colorHex ('#rrggbb'), vehicleFallbackPaint (paint from /vehicles/common/paintLibraries/common.paintLibrary.json closest to the color, by squared RGB distance), vehicle }. Modifying the returned table does not change the stored persona.

set(number, data) stores id, displayName, icon, color, vehicle; a displayName equal to the default name is not stored (to follow language changes). Each modification increments the revision (getRevision), which lets UIs detect a change.
'Solo' color: applySoloColor replaces a persona's color with a gray (0.37, 0.37, 0.39) and recomputes colorHex and vehicleFallbackPaint; useful when there is only one player.

Allowed icons (pool of 19): explosion, hingeBroken, drag01, trafficCone, engine, mirrorInteriorMiddle, doorFrontDetached, vehicleTrunk, carCrash, barrelKnocker01, bollard, drift01, hazardLights, N2OHoriz, rangeboxHi, rallyHelmet, road, tire3Fourth, tireDeflated. Default icons advance one step per persona number, so there are no duplicates as long as there are fewer than 19 players.
The module is a simple module of functions (no hooks).

get.desc: Builds and returns the persona of the given number (stored values + default values).

returns.desc: Persona, or nil if the number is not valid.

preview.desc: Builds a purely default persona (without the stored values) for a number (1 if invalid).

applySoloColor.desc: Replaces in place a persona's color with the 'solo' gray and recomputes colorHex and vehicleFallbackPaint.

returns.desc: The same table (or the received value if it is not a table).

getNumberForPlayer.desc: Converts a local player index (0, 1, 2...) to a persona number (index + 1).

getDefaultDisplayName.desc: Default name: translation of 'ui.multiseat.playerTag' with { number }, otherwise 'Player N' if core_locales is not loaded.

getDefaultIcon.desc: Default icon of a persona, taken from the pool with a random offset fixed for the session.

getIconPool.desc: Returns a copy of the list of available persona icons.

isPersonaIcon.desc: Indicates whether an icon is part of the persona icon pool.

set.desc: Stores a persona's data (id, displayName, icon, color, vehicle) and increments the revision.

returns.desc: true if stored, false if the arguments are invalid.

clear.desc: Clears a persona's stored data (back to default values).

getRevision.desc: Returns the revision counter, incremented on every persona change.

invalidate.desc: Increments the revision without changing anything, to force UIs to refresh.

snapshot.desc: Deep copy of the state: { personas, revision }.

replaceAll.desc: Replaces all personas with those of a table (keys = numbers, or the number field of each element) then increments the revision.

values.desc: Table of personas { id, displayName, icon, color, vehicle }.

returns.desc: false if values is not a table.

restoreSnapshot.desc: Restores the state from a snapshot() snapshot and increments the revision.

returns.desc: false if the snapshot is invalid.
